repositoryFacts: ExtractedRecoveryAssessment.kt derives the population from the model and emits schemaVersion, state, modelSchemaVersion, modelSha256, unassessedEntityIds, and an empty assessedEntityIds array.
SourceTree.kt publishes that model-bound object in reports/confidence.json while retaining structural heuristic scores separately.
ArchivalAudit.kt publishes the same model-bound object in reports/archival_audit.json; its broader unresolvedEntityIds also includes provenance, implementation, and compilation diagnostics.
SourceTree.kt, Main.kt, and WebViews.kt preserve unassessed or unavailable recovery accuracy instead of treating extraction, compilation, or heuristic scores as correctness.
ArchivalAuditProvenanceTest.kt checks the model hash and population linkage between confidence and archival audit reports for historical and schema-2 models.
